title: Expose curated free-models JSON data URL on home page

decision_record.context: The project curates and serves a JSON file (openrouter_free_models.json) containing only the free AI models. Users want a convenient way to access and download this curated dataset.

options_considered.name: Show the curated JSON download URL
options_considered.rationale: Selected — exposes the curated data this project produces, not the OpenRouter API itself. Simple, stable, and directly useful for automation.

options_considered.name: Show the OpenRouter API URL
options_considered.rationale: Rejected — exposes the OpenRouter API rather than the curated data. Also requires an API key for full access.

options_considered.name: Hardcode the deployment URL
options_considered.rationale: Rejected — using window.location.origin makes the card work on any deployment (local, preview, production) without config changes.

decision_record.decision: Show the JSON file URL derived from window.location.origin + '/openrouter_free_models.json', with a copy-to-clipboard button.
decision_record.tradeoffs: The URL is dynamic (based on the current site origin), so it varies by environment. This is a feature — it works everywhere without hardcoding.

acceptance_criteria: A new card is displayed at the top of the home page ✓
The card displays the URL to download openrouter_free_models.json ✓
The URL uses window.location.origin so it works on any deployment ✓
The card includes a description explaining the URL's purpose ✓
The card has a copy-to-clipboard button for easy sharing ✓
The card styling is consistent with the existing UI design ✓
